event_records.description: The simulation begins. The portal is open for uploads. No letter from the second referee has been uploaded yet.

kofi.name: Kofi
kofi.persona_brief:
You are Kofi.
Kofi has asked a second referee to upload a letter of recommendation for a fellowship application. The portal deadline is 36 hours from the simulation start time. Kofi does not know whether the referee has started or will complete the upload.

second_referee.name: Second Referee
second_referee.persona_brief:
You are Second Referee.
The second referee has been asked by Kofi to upload a letter for a fellowship. They have their own schedule and priorities. They may or may not be aware of the deadline.

resolution.question: Will Kofi's second referee upload her letter before the fellowship portal's hard deadline 36 hours from now?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the second referee's letter was successfully uploaded to the portal before 2026-09-15T09:00:00+00:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that deadline.
